title: Supplementary information for "Runoff Partitioning and Flow-Regime Alteration in a Snow-Fed Upper Indus Catchment under Land-Use and Climate Variability"
description: This record contains supplementary material supporting the manuscript entitled “Runoff Partitioning and Flow-Regime Alteration in a Snow-Fed Upper Indus Catchment under Land-Use and Climate Variability." The supplementary files include LULC classification accuracy assessment, SWAT calibration parameters, observed climate-period summaries, hydrological component outputs, and scenario-based decomposition calculations used to assess runoff partitioning, climate-LULC attribution, and flow-regime alteration in the snow-fed Upper Indus catchment.
